schema.title: Response Inference History Inference History Get

post.description:
Submit a continual-learning job (async).

Materializes the task-B dataset(s), trains a new model via the gnn_vuln library, evaluates
it on the task-B test split (metrics-only), and registers the result. The library runs in
API mode (`GNN_VULN_API_MODE`): no research artifacts — per-sample CSVs, ROC/confusion/PR
plots, training log/curves — touch the worker disk. The metrics, the realized
train/val/test split, and the training summary are persisted as per-model `model_artifacts`
(DB + object storage), then the local results dir is deleted. Poll `GET /relearn/{job_id}`.

Train a NEW model from scratch (async).

Architecture + train hyperparameters come from `config_id`; data from `dataset_ids`. Runs on
the same worker pipeline as /relearn but with fresh weights — no EWC
importance, no replay buffer. Registers the trained model and stores its metrics + split +
training summary as model_artifacts. Poll `GET /train/{job_id}`. To CONTINUE an existing
model instead of starting fresh, use `/relearn`.

get.description:
General label-free evaluation of a model over its recent inference history.

No ground-truth labels needed — it summarizes the predictions the model already made
(stored per inference): usage count (`n_history`), prediction mix
(`prediction_distribution`), `mean_confidence`, and a nested **drift** signal.

Drift compares the newest `window` predictions (current) against the `window` before
them (reference) using PSI on the class distribution + mean-confidence drop + pre-head
embedding-centroid cosine shift. `drift.drift = true` is the trigger to relearn.
Extensible to more eval facets later.

parameters.name: window

schema.description: Comparison-window size for the drift signal. The endpoint pulls the most recent 2×window stored predictions and splits them into the newest `window` (current) vs the `window` before it (reference); drift compares the two. Older predictions are ignored. Smaller = more sensitive but noisier; larger = more stable but slower to react. The general stats also cover these 2×window rows, so n_history is capped at 2×window, not the lifetime total.

file.title: File
file.description: .json (array of rows, or object with a 'rows' array) or .jsonl (one row per line)

name.title: Name
name.description: Dataset name; falls back to the file's 'name', then the filename

config.title: Config
config.description: DataConfigOverride as a JSON object string; overrides the file's 'config'

top_cwe.title: Top Cwe
top_cwe.description: Keep only top-N CWE classes (0 = all)

max_per_class.title: Max Per Class
max_per_class.description: Balance: max samples per class (0 = unlimited)

DataConfigOverride.title: DataConfigOverride
DataConfigOverride.description:
Data-build config — frozen onto the dataset. All overridable; defaults are
production-sensible (small val split, no test held out — test = forgetting eval
on old data + drift monitoring).

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Raw functions to build the dataset from (ingest path)

dataset_ids.title: Dataset Ids
dataset_ids.description: Registered dataset ids to MERGE into a new dataset (merge path)

data_config_id.title: Data Config Id
data_config_id.description: Base data-build config to reuse (prior). The `config` object below overrides its fields. Omit to use `config` alone.

config.description: Data-build params — inline config when data_config_id is absent, or field overrides on top of data_config_id when it is set.

DatasetIngestRequest.title: DatasetIngestRequest
DatasetIngestRequest.description:
Provide EXACTLY ONE of `rows` (ingest from raw functions) or `dataset_ids`
(merge >=2 already-registered datasets into a new one).

label.title: Label
label.description: Explicit class id (alternative to cwe; 0 = benign)

func_after.title: Func After
func_after.description: Patched function; flaw lines derived from the diff

flaw_lines.title: Flaw Lines
flaw_lines.description: Manually annotated 1-indexed vulnerable lines of `code`. Alternative to func_after — supply one or the other, not both. Ignored on benign rows.

drift.title: Drift
drift.description: True if a significant shift is detected (PSI>=0.25 or confidence drop>=0.10)

class_psi.title: Class Psi
class_psi.description: Population Stability Index on the predicted-class distribution

confidence_delta.title: Confidence Delta
confidence_delta.description: current minus reference mean confidence (negative = model less sure)

embedding_centroid_cosine_shift.title: Embedding Centroid Cosine Shift
embedding_centroid_cosine_shift.description: cosine distance between the mean pre-head embedding of each window

DriftSignal.title: DriftSignal
DriftSignal.description:
Label-free drift signal: the newest `window` predictions (current) vs the `window`
before them (reference).

model_id.title: Model Id
model_id.description: Registered model id whose embedding space to use

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: List of C/C++/Java function source strings

cls_embedding.title: Cls Embedding
cls_embedding.description: Final pre-head function representation (the vector fed to the output head). For similarity search / drift detection.

n_history.title: N History
n_history.description: predictions analysed (capped at 2×window, not the lifetime total)

prediction_distribution.title: Prediction Distribution
prediction_distribution.description: count per predicted class over the analysed rows

drift.description: null until there are >=4 stored predictions

EvalReport.title: EvalReport
EvalReport.description: General label-free evaluation of a model over its recent inference history.

cls_embedding_dim.title: Cls Embedding Dim
cls_embedding_dim.description: Dimensionality of the stored pre-head function embedding (full vector persisted for drift detection / similarity search, not returned in this response)

top_k_lines.title: Top K Lines
top_k_lines.description: Return only the top-k suspicious lines per function (all if null)

InferenceConfig.title: InferenceConfig
InferenceConfig.description: Inference-time options, kept separate from the call essentials (model_id + codes).

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: List of C/C++/Java function source strings

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Compact eval summary on the task-B test split (function-level classification + localization). The full metrics_summary, the training_summary, and the realized train/val/test split are stored as model_artifacts (kinds: metrics, training_summary, train_split).

dataset_ids.title: Dataset Ids
dataset_ids.description: Task-B dataset id(s). More than one are joined before training.

base_model_id.title: Base Model Id
base_model_id.description: Required — the model to continue from. Its dataset, config and checkpoint are read from the registry. To train a fresh model instead, use POST /train.

run_name.title: Run Name
run_name.description: Optional human label for the job

config.description: Config overrides on the base model's config for this run (epochs, split). Everything else here is job spec, not config. Omit = use the base config as-is.

split.description: Optional split control. Mode A: explicit {train,val,test} parquet_id lists. Mode B: {train_ratio,val_ratio,seed} for the library to split. Omit = default 80/10/10 seed 42.

RunConfig.title: RunConfig
RunConfig.description:
Config overrides applied on top of the inherited config for ONE run — kept separate from
the job spec (method, datasets, base_model). Omit any field to keep the inherited value.

split.description: Optional split control. Mode A: explicit {train,val,test} parquet_id lists. Mode B: {train_ratio,val_ratio,seed} for the library to split. Omit = default 80/10/10 seed 42.

model_type.title: Model Type
model_type.description: Override the architecture from config_id (e.g. lmgat_codebert, lmgat_seqgnn). Omit = use the architecture in config_id.

TrainConfig.title: TrainConfig
TrainConfig.description:
Run-config overrides for /train — RunConfig (epochs, split) plus an optional architecture
override applied on top of config_id.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Compact eval summary on the test split (function-level classification + localization). Full artifacts are stored as model_artifacts, same as /relearn.

config_id.title: Config Id
config_id.description: Registered config to instantiate the model (architecture + train hyperparameters). The dataset(s) provide the data.

dataset_ids.title: Dataset Ids
dataset_ids.description: Dataset id(s) to train on. More than one are joined first.

run_name.title: Run Name
run_name.description: Optional human label for the job

config.description: Config overrides on config_id (epochs, split, model_type). Omit = use config_id as-is.

TrainRequest.title: TrainRequest
TrainRequest.description:
Train a brand-new model from scratch. The architecture + train hyperparameters come from
`config_id`; the data from `dataset_ids`. (Continuing an existing model is `/relearn`.)
